summary.text: Jose Marte is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 20, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the September 8 Republican primary.
Marte also ran for the same seat in 2024 and for the Manchester Board of School Committee in 2025.

paragraphs.text: Jose Marte first appeared on the ballot for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 20, in 2024, when Marte and Pierre Dupont advanced from the Republican primary.
Incumbents Alissandra Murray and Dupont defeated Marte and Joshua Query in the November 5, 2024 general election.
In 2025 Marte ran for the Manchester Board of School Committee, Ward 9, and was defeated by incumbent Bob Baines in the November 4 general election.
Ballotpedia lists Marte as having signed the U.S. Term Limits Pledge in 2024.
